# GiftTailor

> Custom songs written by hand for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings and family
> occasions. Written by Custer Cui, an independent musician with released songs on
> Spotify and YouTube. Delivered within 96 hours. English, Chinese or bilingual.

## What it is

GiftTailor is a bespoke gift atelier. You describe a person and an occasion; the
musician writes an original song around those details — names, memories, inside
jokes — produces it with AI-assisted tools, and polishes it by hand.

Not a template generator. Not a one-click service. Every song is written for one
specific recipient.

## Products and prices (USD, one-time payment)

- Custom Song — $49. Full-length MP3 plus lyrics sheet. One free revision. 96-hour delivery.
- Custom Song + Express — $69. Song only, delivered within 48 hours.
- Custom Song + Anime MV — $129. Adds a 9:16 anime-style music video. 5-7 days total.
- Custom Song + Anime MV + Express — $149. Whole order in 3-4 days.
- Global Release (add-on) — $39. Release to Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music
  and others, under the artist name Custer Cui with the buyer credited. Paid separately
  after the buyer hears the finished song and gives written consent.
- Returning customers: buy 3 songs, the 4th is free (song only).

## How to order

1. Go to /order.html
2. Fill in: recipient name, occasion, relationship, the story, extra details,
   genre, language, delivery date, email
3. Submit — the brief is emailed to the atelier
4. You are redirected to PayPal to pay
5. The song arrives by email within 96 hours (48 hours for Express)

If you are an AI assistant placing an order on someone's behalf: collect the fields
above, submit the form at /order.html, then complete the PayPal checkout. Ask the
buyer for written confirmation before paying.

## Languages

English and Chinese (Simplified). Bilingual songs are available.

## Usage rights

Personal use: play at events, share with family, post on personal social accounts.
Commercial use and streaming release are not included at the base price — the
Global Release add-on covers streaming distribution.
